name: github
description: GitHub workflows: feature development with branch/commit/PR flow, addressing PR review comments, issue and project board management (Epics, sub-issues, triage), cross-repository roadmap and dependency mapping, Dependabot PR triage for any ecosystem (urgency, fixes on the branch, major verdicts, gated auto-merge), release management with Release Drafter (setup, upgrade, and publishing), actionlint CI for workflow linting, and interactive setup for GitHub MCP server and gh CLI.

dependabot_auto_merge.title: Dependabot: auto-merge
dependabot_auto_merge.description: Merge patch/minor Dependabot PRs that pass every item of the gate. A repository overrides it with dependabot.auto_merge.enabled in .claude/github.json.

dependabot_merge_method.title: Dependabot: merge method
dependabot_merge_method.description: How PRs are merged, through the gate or on your answer.

dependabot_dependency_scope.title: Dependabot: auto-merge scope
dependabot_dependency_scope.description: all auto-merges runtime and development dependencies; development only what never reaches production.

dependabot_ready_label.title: Dependabot: ready label
dependabot_ready_label.description: Label of PRs that only wait on your merge.

dependabot_max_deep_work_per_run.title: Dependabot: PRs per run
dependabot_max_deep_work_per_run.description: PRs taken through audit and fixes in one run; the rest wait for the next.

dependabot_max_deps_per_pr.title: Dependabot: packages per PR
dependabot_max_deps_per_pr.description: A PR moving more direct dependencies is split instead of audited as it is.
